Name: Christmas_Carol
$Comment: The carol line: one line this file adds to every other character's conversation while Christmas runs,
on the screens a conversation opens on, after a screen's own lines and before the goodbye group. It
reaches characters that have a conversation of their own; the game's own merchants and townsfolk have
none, so they never show it. Dialogues.Exclude keeps it out of Santa's conversation: nobody sings to
the man who brought the presents. Tomas, Elsie and Bram stand in the Forgotten Temple all Christmas,
so there is always somebody to sing to.
Once with Period Daily and PerCharacter true, keyed by OnceId, is kept per character: a player sings
to each character once a day, and the line comes back at midnight UTC. Grant hands the singer a candy
cane and a little favor on Santa's Nice List every time, all Christmas long (the Reputation reward;
Amount is how much). MarkTalked with no Target credits whoever the player is talking to, and its
Qualifier, Christmas_Carol, is what the carol tour's step counts (Santa's quest christmas_carols), so
no other talk step on the server moves the tour; while the tour is not carried the credit counts for
nothing. The line names no Goto and no Close, so the conversation stays on the screen it was on, the
line gone for the day, and the library's receipt toast shows inside it with the pickup sound. Season
hides the line whenever Christmas is off; to take it out everywhere, set Enabled false in a file of
